name: append_new_security_section
transcript_text:
Ella: We need to add a Secrets Management section to the Security Policy page. We're adopting HashiCorp Vault and it's not documented anywhere yet.
Finn: Yes, let's add a Vault section after Encryption.

confluence_workspace_pages.title: Security Policy
confluence_workspace_pages.content_html:
Authentication Standard

SAML for enterprise sign-ins.

Encryption

AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.

expected_proposals.new_text: HashiCorp Vault is used for secrets management. All service credentials must be stored in Vault.
